performance.verdict: Ads dark 16 days; GBP and organic holding but pipeline intake is broken.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 every day since 2026-08-06 — 19 consecutive zero-spend days, all leads have stopped.
GHL shows 27 contacts created but 0 opportunities opened and 0 appointments — leads that did arrive never entered the pipeline.
SOW extension with Marwan is open and unresolved; the 3-month renewal gates all Aug–Sep campaign and creative work listed in the plan.
3-day sc_clicks signal: Aug 22–24 averaged 16.3 vs prior 3-day avg of 25.3 — search click momentum fading without paid support.
IG reach spiked to 210 on Aug 21 and 182 on Aug 23 despite zero paid spend — organic posts still active but no conversion path behind them.

suggestions.text: Identify and resolve cause of Meta $0 spend since Aug 6; restore to $65–75/day immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has delivered $0 spend and 0 leads for 19 consecutive days since 2026-08-06, ending all lead flow. Diagnose the account — check billing, campaign status, ad set rejections, or account flags — and restore daily budget to $65–75 as per SOW. Success is confirmed when spend resumes at ≥$65/day and the first new leads register in GHL. Resolve by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 27 contacts entered but 0 opportunities created — repair the pipeline stage automation.
suggestions.monday_update: 27 Meta leads reached GHL as contacts over the 28-day window, but 0 opportunities were created and 0 appointments booked — meaning no lead has entered the sales pipeline at all. Work with Andrew to confirm whether the GHL workflow automating contact-to-opportunity conversion is active and correctly mapped. Success is a non-zero opportunity count within 48 hours of leads resuming. Complete audit by 2026-08-27.

suggestions.text: Watch contract extension resolution; no creative or budget scaling until Marwan renewal is confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: The SOW extension with Marwan is open and unresolved, gating all planned Aug–Sep Meta creative work and the 3-month renewal. No new campaign builds, creative shoots, or budget increases should be actioned until the contract is signed. Re-check status on 2026-08-28 and escalate to Sohib if no response received.
